basic_details.job_title: GIPE Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Population Research Centre (PRC), Pune, funded by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, New Delhi, has two contractual Research Assistant posts open at the Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics (GIPE): one Research Assistant – I (Unreserved) on consolidated pay of Rs. 28,000 per month and one Research Assistant - II (OBC) on Rs. 25,000 per month. Both need a 2nd Class Post Graduate degree in a listed subject. Applications are online and the last date is 6 December 2026, 6.00 p.m.

how_to_apply: Submit the duly filled in Online Application Form together with the latest Curriculum Vitae and educational, experience and other related documents.
Pay the online application fee of Rs. 236/-.
Attach self-attested copies of degree or diploma certificates and other certificates supporting educational qualification and experience, and the S.S.C. or equivalent certificate for date of birth.
For the OBC position, include the Caste Certificate and a valid OBC Non-Creamy Layer Certificate as per Government of India format.
If already in service, apply through proper channel with a no objection certificate from the current employer.
Submit the application online by 6 December 2026, 6.00 p.m.

Original certificates should not be sent with the application; they are to be produced at the time of interview. Any change of address given in the application form should be communicated to the Registrar, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, 846, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411 004.

content_sections.heading: About GIPE
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics as one of the oldest research institutes in the country, established in 1930 under the aegis of Servants of India Society. It has been declared a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. The Institute is based at 846, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411 004.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 non-faculty contractual positions in total.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Accepted subjects for the Post Graduate degree, from a recognized Institution / University: Demography / Population Studies / Statistics / Biostatistics / Economics / Mathematics / Sociology / Social work / Psychology / Anthropology / Geography / Public Health. Candidates having a degree from a foreign university must produce an equivalence certificate issued by the Association of Indian University (AIU) while applying. Candidates already in service must apply through proper channel with a no objection certificate from the current employer.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: 2nd Class Post Graduate degree (minimum) in the subjects below. Four years of experience post qualification (i.e. after Post Graduation) /Ph.D. Relaxable in deserving cases.
2nd Class Post Graduate degree (minimum) in the subjects below. One year of experience post qualification (i.e. after Post Graduation). Relaxable in deserving cases.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Research Assistant – I receives consolidated pay of Rs. 28,000/- per month and Research Assistant - II Rs. 25,000/- per month. Hiring is purely on a contractual basis, and the contract is renewed at least every year based on the performance of the Research Assistant. PRC has no liability for regularizing the service rendered or offering regular appointment in the PRC. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview or for joining the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GIPE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit the duly filled in Online Application Form together with the latest Curriculum Vitae and educational, experience and other related documents. Pay the online application fee of Rs. 236/-. Attach self-attested copies of degree or diploma certificates and other certificates supporting educational qualification and experience, and the S.S.C. or equivalent certificate for date of birth. For the OBC position, include the Caste Certificate and a valid OBC Non-Creamy Layer Certificate as per Government of India format. If already in service, apply through proper channel with a no objection certificate from the current employer. Submit the application online by 6 December 2026, 6.00 p.m. Original certificates should not be sent with the application; they are to be produced at the time of interview. Any change of address given in the application form should be communicated to the Registrar, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, 846, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411 004.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute may short-list candidates for interview, as necessary. A Screening Committee appointed for the purpose short-lists candidates from the applications received, and its decision is final and binding. Meeting the minimum qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. The call letter is sent only to short-listed candidates, to their email only. No correspondence is entertained from applicants who are not short-listed. The notice does not give an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in GIPE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts at the Population Research Centre, Pune: one Research Assistant – I (Unreserved) and one Research Assistant - II (OBC).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the GIPE Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission is 6 December 2026, till 6.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GIPE Research Assistant – I and II?
faq.answer: Both posts need at least a 2nd Class Post Graduate degree in Demography, Population Studies, Statistics, Biostatistics, Economics, Mathematics, Sociology, Social work, Psychology, Anthropology, Geography or Public Health from a recognized Institution / University. Research Assistant – I needs four years of post-qualification experience /Ph.D.; Research Assistant - II needs one year.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GIPE Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years as on the date of advertisement. There is no age limit for internal candidates already in the services at this Institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Research Assistant at GIPE PRC?
faq.answer: Research Assistant – I gets consolidated pay of Rs. 28,000/- per month and Research Assistant - II gets Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GIPE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application fee is Rs. 236/-.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the GIPE Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Submit the duly filled in Online Application Form with the latest Curriculum Vitae and self-attested copies of educational, experience and date-of-birth certificates before 6 December 2026, 6.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the GIPE Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee short-lists candidates from the applications received, and short-listed candidates are called for interview by email. Meeting the minimum qualifications alone does not entitle a candidate to an interview call.

faq.question: Q9. Is the GIPE Research Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The hiring is purely on a contractual basis, with the contract renewed at least every year based on performance. PRC has no liability to regularize the service or offer regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the GIPE interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible either for attending the interview or for joining the post.
